## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 413 captures during March 2026. This activity represents the total number of images captured at the site during the reporting month. The result provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes across the clinic’s activity.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 24 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.8 per cent. These images could not be used for a grading outcome and are reported separately from images that proceeded through the grading process. Image quality remains an important consideration when interpreting the overall activity reported for the site.

## Grading

Grading identified 126 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates the typical time taken for an image to progress from capture to a completed grading outcome during March 2026. The grading results and image-quality figures should be considered together when reviewing the month’s operational performance at Harbour Eye Clinic.
